categories.main_business_segments: ZJLD Group Inc is primarily engaged in the production and sales of baijiu, a traditional Chinese liquor. The company offers a diverse portfolio of baijiu products including sauce aroma, mixed aroma, and strong aroma types, with a focus on premium and above price ranges. Its key brands include Zhen Jiu (flagship, sauce aroma), Li Du (mixed aroma), Xiang Jiao (regional premium brand in Hunan), and Kai Kou Xiao (mid-range brand in Hunan).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company inherits and innovates traditional Chinese baijiu brewing techniques, emphasizing quality and unique flavor profiles. It operates seven production facilities equipped with advanced technologies including automated production lines, 3D scanning for base liquor management, and digital quality management systems. The production process includes qu-making, fermentation, distillation, blending, filling, and packaging, supported by proprietary digital systems for inventory and quality control.
categories.primary_customers_markets: ZJLD serves a broad customer base including individual consumers, corporate clients, and distributors across China. It targets premium and deluxe baijiu consumers, business banquet scenarios, and is expanding into duty-free channels in Hong Kong, Macau, and Southeast Asia. The company also develops key corporate clients and leverages e-commerce platforms to reach wider audiences.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with production bases concentrated in Guizhou (notably Zunyi region), Jiangxi, and Hunan provinces. It is expanding its market reach beyond traditional strongholds, including nationwide sales network expansion and initial international steps in Hong Kong, Macau, Southeast Asia, and Japan.
categories.supply_chain_position: ZJLD operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the baijiu supply chain, focusing on production, aging, blending, packaging, and distribution. It is increasing self-production of base liquor to reduce reliance on third-party suppliers, thereby enhancing gross margins and supply control.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality and sustainable development, focusing on brand building, product quality enhancement, channel innovation, and social responsibility. R&D efforts include collaboration with universities and research institutions to improve baijiu flavor and quality, development of new product lines, and digital transformation of production and sales processes. It also emphasizes experiential marketing and expanding consumption scenarios.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through the sale of baijiu products via a nationwide distributor network and direct sales channels, including retail stores, corporate clients, and e-commerce platforms. The company employs a dual-channel growth strategy targeting traditional and emerging channels, with a focus on premium and deluxe product lines.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: ZJLD is a leading baijiu company in China, ranked as the fourth largest sauce aroma baijiu brand nationally and third in Guizhou province by revenue. Its Li Du brand ranks fifth among mixed aroma baijiu brands in China. The company competes in the premium and above segments, leveraging strong brand recognition, product quality, and innovative marketing to differentiate itself in a competitive baijiu market.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, ZJLD reported revenue of approximately RMB7.07 billion, a slight increase from the previous year. Adjusted net profit increased by 3.3% to RMB1.68 billion with an adjusted net profit margin of 23.7%. The company operates with a strong asset base of RMB19.6 billion and maintains a net cash surplus. Growth is driven by premium product lines and expansion into new markets and channels.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: ZJLD emphasizes high-quality baijiu products crafted with traditional and innovative brewing techniques, offering distinctive flavor profiles tailored to diverse consumer preferences. Its value proposition includes premium branding, immersive consumer experiences through tasting events and distillery tours, and a comprehensive digital infrastructure for quality and channel management. The company also integrates cultural heritage and sustainability into its product design and packaging, enhancing brand appeal and customer loyalty.
